continuity_scope: Two explicitly separated North American English retail witnesses: World of Warcraft: Shadowlands, Patch 9.0 launch baseline (23 November 2020, Americas) for the selected character/afterlife cohort, and Blizzard's live Playable Races directory as retrieved 18 August 2026 for the complete set of 26 unique race labels then listed. The terminology snapshot does not rewrite the 9.0 character claims or SRC-135's Dragonflight Patch 10.0 Dragon Aspect cohort.
work_or_witnesses: Blizzard: Shadowlands Content Update Notes (23 November 2020)
Blizzard: Shadowlands Arrives November 23 (global release schedule)
Blizzard: Shadowlands Preview: Revendreth and the Venthyr Covenant
Blizzard: World of Warcraft Playable Races directory (retrieved 18 August 2026)
coverage_rule: Character coverage remains all named individual figures with dedicated official paragraphs in the selected Revendreth launch-content preview, plus Sylvanas Windrunner as the single named actor in the Patch 9.0 launch premise: Sire Denathrius, Prince Renathal, General Draven, and Sylvanas Windrunner. Terminology coverage additionally records every unique playable-race label in the official directory retrieved 18 August 2026: the 14 standard Alliance/Horde labels (deduplicating Pandaren and Dracthyr, which appear under both) and all 12 Allied Race labels (deduplicating Earthen and Haranir, which appear in both Allied Race columns).
omissions: Every SRC-135 Dragonflight character and any Dragonflight claim; no duplicate character record is created.
Player-created adventurers, heroes, Maw Walkers, and player-selected class/race/faction/covenant identities.

Other named figures in the product/preview, including the Arbiter, the Jailer, and unnamed or collectively named inhabitants, because they lack a selected dedicated paragraph under this narrow witness rule.

All post-9.0 Shadowlands character/story claims, raids, later stories, WoW Classic variants, other expansion narratives, Warcraft strategy-game campaigns, Chronicle volumes, novels, comics, and adaptations. The separately dated live directory supports only its displayed playable-race labels and grouping.
Covenants, Venthyr, Stoneborn, zones, anima, dungeons, raids, gear, and systems as character nodes.
uncertainties: World of Warcraft is live service; this pass fixes character claims to the 9.0 launch state, while playable-race terminology is a separately dated 18 August 2026 retrieval and may change after that date.

The official preview presents Sire Denathrius's self-description and Prince Renathal's suspicion. It is publisher narration of a situation with in-world political claims; the records retain the source's qualifiers where they matter and do not adjudicate hidden motives beyond the stated text.
The Warcraft franchise has Chronicle, game-text, novel, comic, adaptation, and future-retcon layers. This pass does not claim to settle their hierarchy or continuity conflicts.
Names and terms follow the North American English localization; localization variants are not merged without an exact official witness.
evidence_basis: First-party Blizzard World of Warcraft launch notes, official global schedule, official Revendreth preview, and the official Playable Races directory. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, or player forum material is used as evidence.
